educationalGoal: The goals of this course are: 1) to provide students with the basic knowledge to use data analysis software in psychological research, and 2) to apply this knowledge to actual data analysis. In addition, we aim to statistically analyze data from previous psychological research and make socially and scientifically meaningful claims and suggestions. Acquire essential research skills in Project Design III.
advice:
Current psychological research requires researchers to use R software, which allows for a variety of statistical analyses, from basic to multivariate (e.g., regression, factorial).
Students also deepen their understanding of sample size design and power analysis, as well as indicators such as effect sizes and confidence intervals in addition to p-values, and gain the ability to calculate them.
R is so useful that students use it in their Project Design III, but it is difficult to learn how to use. Students should take advantage of office hours and peer instruction.

This course is subject to the course credit system.
requiredKnowledge: Students should make use of their previous knowledge of data analysis during the course. Students are expected to review the knowledge on statistical analysis. Students must bring their own personal computer to every class.

5.Power analysis

              The goals of this course are: 1) to provide students with the basic knowledge to use data analysis software in psychological research, and 2) to apply this knowledge to actual data analysis. In addition, we aim to statistically analyze data from previous psychological research and make socially and scientifically meaningful claims and suggestions. Acquire essential research skills in Project Design III.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Current psychological research requires researchers to use R software, which allows for a variety of statistical analyses, from basic to multivariate (e.g., regression, factorial).
Students also deepen their understanding of sample size design and power analysis, as well as indicators such as effect sizes and confidence intervals in addition to p-values, and gain the ability to calculate them.
R is so useful that students use it in their Project Design III, but it is difficult to learn how to use. Students should take advantage of office hours and peer instruction.

This course is subject to the course credit system.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              None

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Students should make use of their previous knowledge of data analysis during the course. Students are expected to review the knowledge on statistical analysis. Students must bring their own personal computer to every class.
